capabilities: Run focus blocks with configurable lengths and breaks
Pick tasks from notes and keep a Today list
Play a chime and generated brown, pink or white noise
Write a focus log line to the daily note
Show focus stats, streaks and time per note
extras: Free and fully offline with no network requests until a Kiri account is connected; the account adds downloaded sounds, binaural beats and history sync. Status bar countdown is not shown on phones and tablets.
problem: Obsidian can list your tasks but cannot time work on them, run breaks, or record how long each task took.

relations.evidence: If you have a Kiri account at project-kiri.com, you can connect it in Settings
Tasks written for the Tasks plugin, like - [ ] Draft intro 📅 2026-11-20, work as they are.

summary: Sidebar focus timer that runs timed blocks on tasks from your notes, with breaks, a chime, generated noise and a log line in the daily note.
